description: This source file implements a transformation pass that converts array return values in functions to out parameters, modifying function prototypes, call sites, and return statements accordingly. It is part of a shader compiler or translator system.

classes.name: ArrayReturnValueToOutParameterTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that modifies the AST to convert array return values into out parameters, handling function prototypes, definitions, call sites, and return statements.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that applies the transformation to the AST root node.

methods.name: createReplacementCall
methods.description: Creates a new function call node with the out parameter added.

methods.name: visitFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Visits function definitions to identify functions with array return types.

methods.name: visitFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Replaces function prototypes with array return types to have out parameters and void return type.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Handles call sites where array return values are used without assignment.

methods.name: visitBranch
methods.description: Replaces return statements with assignments to out parameters.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Replaces array assignment expressions with function call replacements.
